text:
Anya: Morning — final check for tomorrow's webinar. Registration page is live but quick questions: Zoom recording settings? post-event asset flow? lead routing to HubSpot? Rehearsal 11:00am PT. @Matt you host, @Jordan co-host.

Matt: On it. Zoom: record to cloud, auto-transcript enabled, disable breakout rooms, alt hosts: Jordan, Sasha. Will set cohosts.

Jordan: Confirmed as alt host. I can start the recording if host can't. Can we show localized timezones on reg form? We have EMEA signups.

Sasha: Reg page does timezone detection. Updated confirmation copy to: 'Replay available within 24 hours; transcript included.' Also added short privacy blurb.

Leo: Post-event cadence proposed: Day0 - thank you + replay + 30s clip; Day2 - benchmark blog/highlights + CTA; Day7 - invite to trial. Routing: tag leads 'webinar-inference-march2026' into HubSpot list + SFDC campaign. @Anya confirm tag.

Anya: Tag name fine. Need clip plan: 3 clips — 30s social, 90s highlight, 5min demo. Who owns edits?

Sasha: I can own 30s + 90s (our editor will cut). @Leo can own 5min demo with product notes.

Leo: Yep I'll do the 5min.

Jordan: Zoom recording layout: active speaker + shared screen, and please enable separate audio tracks for easier editing. Paste settings below:

```
Recording:
- Record to cloud
- Active speaker + shared screen
- Record separate audio files
- Auto-transcribing ON
- Allow participants to join before host OFF
- Waiting room ON
- Alternative hosts: jordan@redwood.com, sasha@redwood.com
```

Matt: Added cohosts and those recording settings. Also added a custom registration question: 'Which infra do you run inference on?' Options: AWS, GCP, On-prem, Other. Map answers to HubSpot property 'inference_infra'.

Sasha: Zapier flow plan: Zoom registration -> HubSpot contact create/update -> add to list -> webhook to marketing platform to send confirmation email. I have draft Zap names and will share.

Anya: Can we ensure the raw recording lands in S3 for clipping pipeline? Set ACL private, team access only.

Jordan: Zoom will auto-archive to cloud. I'll export to S3 after the event under folder /webinars/2026-03-inference. Who has write perms?

Matt: I created service account zoom-export@redwood with PutObject perms. Will attach IAM doc to this thread.

```
s3://redwood-assets/webinars/2026-03-inference/recordings/
IAM: zoom-export@redwood -> PutObject, ListBucket
```

Sasha: Confirmation email copy draft ready. Subject: 'Thanks for joining — replay & resources'. Body: short intro, link to replay, transcript VTT attached, 3 bullet TL;DR, CTA to try Redwood API.

Leo: Lead scoring rules: +10 for trial_signup click, +5 for download benchmark. SDR alert for any lead >50 seats or leads scoring >20 within 48h.

Anya: Rehearsal checklist — start 15 min early, slides check, mic/test share, backup hotspot for presenter, record a 30s intro fallback audio. @Matt please run.

Matt: I'll start at T-15 and ping #ops for network standby. Also prepping a livestream fallback (YouTube) if Zoom has streaming issues — stream key ready.

ops-bot: Reminder: rehearsal scheduled 2026-03-22 18:00 UTC (11:00 PT).

Sasha: One last production ask: include caption burn-in for social clips. Editor can use the Zoom VTT for accurate captions.

Jordan: All set on my side. I'll start recording at T=0 if Matt is delayed. Folder path, tags and HubSpot mapping in a doc I'll upload after lunch.

Anya: :thumbsup: Thanks team — I'll drop final run-of-show and email templates into this thread tonight.
